opening.argument: The visible CRED app screens support an ordinary referral-and-cashback promotion. A referral card offers a minimum ₹500 reward, while the trophy room shows cashback cards for ₹500 and ₹6. The speaker explains the referral reward and walks viewers through installing the app, adding a bank account and credit card, and making an initial payment for possible cashback. Those instructions are presented alongside app functions for credit-card bill and rent payments. The record shows a promotion and payment tutorial, not observed impersonation, false destination behavior, credential theft, or victim loss.
